SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_USED_LISTING
WHERE USED_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT U.USED_NO usedNo , U.USER_NO userNo , U.USED_TITLE usedTitle , U.USED_CONTENT usedContent , U.USED_PRICE usedPrice , U.STATUS status , U.ENROLL_DATE enrollDate , U.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , CAT.CATEGORY_NAME categoryName , U.THUMBNAIL thumbnail FROM CT_USED_LISTING U JOIN CT_USED_CATEGORY CAT ON U.CATEGORY = CAT.CATEGORY_NO WHERE U.USED_NO = #{usedNo}

SELECT MANUFACTURER manufacturer , MODEL model , CAR_YEAR carYear , DISTANCE distance , TRANSMISSION transmission , FUEL_TYPE fuelType , REGION region , CAR_COLOR carColor , PHONE FROM CT_CAR_INFO WHERE USED_NO = #{usedNo}
SELECT FILE_NO fileNo , REF_BNO refBno , ORIGIN_NAME originName , CHANGE_NAME changeName , FILE_PATH filePath FROM CT_USED_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{usedNo} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_USED_LISTING WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
AND STATUS = #{status}
